translations.literal: Afterward Kang Chengxun pacified Xufang and there was the chronicle of Wuning from beginning to end.
translations.idiomatic: Later Kang Chengxun pacified Xuzhou and there was a full account of the Wuning campaign.

sentences.zh: 如此事類，記述頗多。

translations.literal: Matters of this sort are quite numerous in the records.
translations.idiomatic: Accounts of this kind are numerous.

sentences.zh: 請下中外臣僚及名儒宿學，有於此六十年內撰述得傳記及中書、銀臺、史館日曆、制敕冊書等，不限年月多少，並許詣闕進納。

translations.literal: We request that an order be sent to civil and military officials within and without and to renowned Confucians and veteran scholars: whoever within these sixty years has composed biographies, calendars of the Secretariat, Silver Terrace, or History Office, edicts, investiture documents, and the like, regardless of how many years they cover, is permitted to come to court and present them.
translations.idiomatic: We ask that civil and military officials at court and in the provinces, and eminent scholars, be notified: anyone who within these sixty years has written biographies, Secretariat or Silver Terrace or History Office calendars, edicts, investiture documents, or the like—whatever the span of years—may bring them to court.

sentences.zh: 如年月稍多，記錄詳備，請特行簡拔，不限資序。

translations.literal: If the years are rather extensive and the records detailed and complete, we request special selection and promotion without regard to qualification or seniority.
translations.idiomatic: If the coverage is broad and the record thorough, we ask for special promotion without regard to rank or seniority.

sentences.zh: 臣與張昭遠等所撰《唐史》，敘本紀以綱帝業，列傳以述功臣，十誌以書刑政。

translations.literal: The History of Tang that your subjects, together with Zhang Zhaoyuan and others, are compiling sets forth basic annals to frame the imperial enterprise, arranges biographies to narrate meritorious ministers, and uses the ten treatises to record punishments and government.
translations.idiomatic: The History of Tang that we are compiling with Zhang Zhaoyuan and others uses annals to frame the imperial enterprise, biographies to recount meritorious ministers, and ten treatises to record law and administration.

sentences.zh: 所陳條例，請下所司。」

translations.literal: The regulations we have set forth are requested to be transmitted to the responsible offices."
translations.idiomatic: We ask that the regulations we have proposed be sent to the responsible offices."

sentences.zh: 從之。）〉

translations.literal: The memorial was approved.)〉
translations.idiomatic: The court approved.)〉

sentences.zh: 壬寅，以戶部員外郎、知制誥盧價為虞部郎中、知制誥，以昭義節度副使陳元為光祿卿致仕。

translations.literal: On renyin, Lu Jia, Outer Director in the Ministry of Revenue and drafter of rescripts, was made Director in the Ministry of Works and drafter of rescripts; Chen Yuan, deputy military governor of the Zhaoyi Army, was made retired Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, Lu Jia, Outer Director in the Ministry of Revenue and drafter of rescripts, became Director in the Ministry of Works with the same drafting duty; Chen Yuan, deputy military governor of the Zhaoyi Army, retired as Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，齊、魯民饑，詔兗、鄆、青三州發廩賑貸。

translations.literal: On yisi, the people of Qi and Lu suffered famine; an edict ordered Yanzhou, Yunzhou, and Qingzhou to open granaries for relief loans.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, the people of Qi and Lu were starving; an edict ordered Yanzhou, Yunzhou, and Qingzhou to open their granaries for relief.

sentences.zh: 五月庚申朔，以前邢州節度使丁審琪為延州節度使，延州節度使劉景嚴為邠州節度使。

translations.literal: On the first day, gengshen, of the fifth month, Ding Shenqi, former military governor of Xingzhou, was made military governor of Yanzhou; Liu Jingyan, military governor of Yanzhou, was made military governor of Binzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon of the fifth month, Ding Shenqi, former military governor of Xingzhou, became military governor of Yanzhou, and Liu Jingyan, military governor of Yanzhou, became military governor of Binzhou.

sentences.zh: 故皇子杲冊贈太尉，進封陳王。

translations.literal: The late imperial prince Gao was posthumously enfeoffed by investiture document as Grand Marshal and advanced to Prince of Chen.
translations.idiomatic: The late imperial prince Gao was posthumously honored as Grand Marshal and advanced to Prince of Chen by investiture.

sentences.zh: 庚午，涇州奏，雨雹，川水大溢，壞州郡鎮戍二十四城。

translations.literal: On gengwu, Jingzhou reported: hail fell, river waters overflowed greatly, and twenty-four prefectural, commandery, and garrison cities were destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Jingzhou reported hail, severe flooding, and damage to twenty-four prefectural and garrison cities.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，北京遣牙將劉從以吐渾大首領白承福、念龐裏、赫連功德來朝。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, the Northern Capital dispatched the military officer Liu Cong to escort the Tuyuhun great chieftains Bai Chengfu, Nian Pangli, and Helian Gongde to court.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, the Northern Capital sent military officer Liu Cong to escort the Tuyuhun chieftains Bai Chengfu, Nian Pangli, and Helian Gongde to court.

sentences.zh: 邢州上言，吐渾移族帳於鎮州封部。

translations.literal: Xingzhou reported upward that the Tuyuhun had moved their tribal encampments into the jurisdictional territory of Zhenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Xingzhou reported that the Tuyuhun had moved their encampments into Zhenzhou's jurisdiction.

sentences.zh: 六月丙申，以前衛尉卿趙延乂為司天監。

translations.literal: In the sixth month on bingshen, Zhao Yanyi, former Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, was made Director of the Astronomy Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month on bingshen, Zhao Yanyi, former Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, became Director of the Astronomy Bureau.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，詔：「今後藩侯郡守，凡有善政，委倅貳官條件聞奏，百姓官吏等不得遠詣京闕。」

translations.literal: On dingyou, an edict declared: "Henceforth for frontier lords and prefectural governors, whenever there is good governance, the deputy officials are to set forth the particulars in memorials; commoners and officials may not travel far to the capital gate."
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, an edict declared: "Henceforth, when a frontier lord or prefect achieves good governance, deputy officials shall report the particulars in memorials; commoners and officials may not travel to the capital on their own."

sentences.zh: 壬寅，右領衛上將軍李頃卒，贈太師。

translations.literal: On renyin, Li Qing, Senior General of the Right Leading Guard, died; he was posthumously made Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, Li Qing, Senior General of the Right Leading Guard, died and was posthumously honored as Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，迦葉彌陀國僧唵室哩以佛牙泛海而至。

translations.literal: On jiachen, the monk Anshili of the Kasyapa Amitabha country brought the Buddha's tooth across the sea.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, the monk Anshili from the Kasyapa Amitabha kingdom arrived by sea bearing a Buddha's tooth relic.

sentences.zh: 丙午，高麗國王王建加開府儀同三司、檢校太師，食邑一萬戶。

translations.literal: On bingwu, Wang Jian, king of Goryeo, was additionally made Grand Master of Splendid Happiness with the Same Three Departments and Honorary Grand Preceptor, with a fief of ten thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Wang Jian, king of Goryeo, received the additional titles of Grand Master of Splendid Happiness with the Same Three Departments and Honorary Grand Preceptor, with a fief of ten thousand households.

sentences.zh: 戊午，鎮州節度使安重榮執契丹使拽剌，遣輕騎掠幽州南境之民，處於博野。

translations.literal: On wuwu, An Chongrong, military governor of Zhenzhou, seized the Khitan envoy Zhuaila, dispatched light cavalry to plunder the populace of the southern border of Youzhou, and settled them at Boye.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, An Chongrong, military governor of Zhenzhou, seized the Khitan envoy Zhuaila, sent light cavalry to raid the southern border of Youzhou, and resettled the captives at Boye.

sentences.zh: 仍貢表及馳書天下，述契丹援天子父事之禮，貪傲無厭，困耗中國，已繕治甲兵，將與決戰。

translations.literal: He also presented a memorial and dispatched letters throughout the realm, describing how the Khitan supported the Son of Heaven with the rites due a father, yet were greedy, arrogant, and insatiable, draining and exhausting China; he had already repaired armor and weapons and was about to join battle.
translations.idiomatic: He also sent a memorial and letters throughout the realm, denouncing the Khitan for treating the emperor as a son while remaining greedy and arrogant, draining the realm, and declaring that he had already prepared arms for decisive battle.

sentences.zh: 帝發諭而止之。

translations.literal: The Emperor issued an edict of instruction to stop him.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor issued an edict instructing him to desist.

sentences.zh: 重榮跋扈愈甚，由是與襄州節度使安從進潛相構謀為不軌。

translations.literal: Chongrong grew ever more overbearing and domineering; thereby he and An Congjin, military governor of Xiangzhou, secretly plotted together for treason.
translations.idiomatic: Chongrong grew increasingly defiant, and he and An Congjin, military governor of Xiangzhou, secretly conspired in treason.
